text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌۭ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌۭ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُنَّ ۖ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَٰبِ ۖ بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

words.gloss_range: direct vocative particle opening a formal address
words.prose: The vocative particle {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) opens the ayah as direct address before any rule is stated. Its payoff is scope: the social prohibitions land on the hearers as a formal summons.

topics.headline: direct address scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the law begin as direct summons, so the following prohibitions are addressed to the audience rather than reported at a distance.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on direct-address scope and the opening position before the prohibition chain.

words.gloss_range: vocative specifier that mediates the address toward a defined addressee
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّ}} ({{tr:ayyu}}) mediates the call by preparing a specified addressee rather than a loose exclamation. The word keeps the opening address formally directed.

topics.headline: vocative specification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the call is not left vague; it is shaped into a specified addressee before the faith clause arrives.
topics.reason: The row identifies the word as the vocative specification between the summons and the relative addressee.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun restricting the addressee class
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) restricts the address to a defined group and lets the following verb complete that identity. The prohibition chain therefore begins inside an already named community.

topics.headline: restricted addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is grammatically narrowed to a class before the conduct rules begin.
topics.reason: The rows treat the relative clause as completing the vocative identity and limiting the addressee class.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form IV plural naming an already-entered faith or trust state
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, and faith; Form IV locally marks entry into the trust commitment
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) completes the opening identity as a prior, plural commitment, not a future aspiration. Through {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}), the word brings security, trust, and faith into the address; nearby links in the surah, including 49:6, 49:12, and 49:14, make the later social violations betray the same trust-field.

topics.headline: prior trust identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the prohibitions address people already placed inside a trust identity, making social harm a breach of that security rather than generic bad manners.
topics.reason: The rows combine perfect 3mp grammar, Form IV entry into trust, the formal believer-address formula, and surah-level faith bookends.

words.gloss_range: negative particle with prohibitive force governing a jussive verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is the first prohibitive marker and governs the following jussive action. It opens the fourfold chain of restraints rather than standing as an isolated negation.

topics.headline: first prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the first boundary marker that starts the ayah’s repeated social prohibitions.
topics.reason: The rows identify prohibitive governance and the beginning of the repeated prohibition sequence.

words.gloss_range: jussive Form I ridicule verb; broader subjugation branches are present as background, not the local form
words.root_gloss_range: ridicule and subjection are both in the root field; local Form I selects mockery while leaving domination as the social shadow
words.prose: {{ar:يَسْخَرْ}} ({{tr:yaskhar}}) is a jussive singular after the prohibition, so one collective subject can be restrained as a single acting group. The {{ar:س خ ر}} ({{tr:s-kh-r}}) field makes ridicule feel like social lowering, while the local Form I keeps the active sense at mockery; Quranic contempt scenes such as 15:11, 21:41, and 43:32 stay as parallels, not as a different local verb.

topics.headline: ridicule under command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ridicule as a prohibited act of lowering others, while grammar keeps the local sense to mockery rather than explicit causative subjugation.
topics.reason: The rows support jussive governance, collective singular agreement, ridicule/subjugation range, Form I narrowing, inter-ayah parallels, and sound pressure.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative group noun functioning as the mocking subject
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, and group identity; locally a social group presented without naming a specific faction
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمٌۭ}} ({{tr:qawmun}}) is indefinite and nominative, making the mocking party any group rather than a named faction. Its {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) background of standing lets the social unit appear as a group with public posture and status.

topics.headline: indefinite standing group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the subject is any standing group, so the warning does not target one named party.
topics.reason: The rows connect nominative indefiniteness, the standing-group image, named-group avoidance, and the later women-panel contrast.

words.gloss_range: preposition separating one group from another in the comparison frame
words.prose: {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}) separates the source group from the target group and keeps the comparison frame balanced. It makes the social harm relational: one group is set over against another.

topics.headline: separative min
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees mockery as a relation between separated parties, not merely an internal feeling of contempt.
topics.reason: The rows identify separation, partitive pressure, and the balanced group-from-group structure.

words.gloss_range: genitive target group governed by the preceding preposition
words.root_gloss_range: standing-group field; locally the mocked group shares the same group-status vocabulary as the mockers
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمٍ}} ({{tr:qawmin}}) is the governed target of the prepositional frame. Repeating the {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) group-word on both sides makes the mockers and mocked grammatically comparable before the counter-evaluation arrives.

topics.headline: governed target group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the mocked party is linguistically the same kind of standing group as the mockers.
topics.reason: The rows focus on genitive governance, the completed group-from-group frame, repeated qawm vocabulary, and the turn toward counter-evaluation.

words.gloss_range: uninflected hope or expectation verb introducing a counter-evaluation
words.root_gloss_range: hope, possibility, and expectation; locally a divine-speech modal that unsettles the mockers’ judgment
words.prose: {{ar:عَسَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ʿasā}}) introduces a counter-evaluation: the mocked group may prove better than the mockers. The {{ar:ع س ي}} ({{tr:ʿ-s-y}}) range holds hope and expectation together; variant plural readings sharpen the subject relation but do not replace the local uninflected form.

topics.headline: modal counter evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah interrupts social contempt with a possible divine counter-ranking of the mocked group.
topics.reason: The rows support modal counter-evaluation, hope/certainty range, divine-speech force, and qiraat-based contrast.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive complement particle forming the content of the modal evaluation
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) turns the modal opening into a dependent complement. It makes the possibility concrete by requiring the following clause to state what may be true of the mocked group.

topics.headline: complement dependency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the counter-evaluation is not vague; it is grammatically filled by a following being-clause.
topics.reason: The row identifies the particle as creating a maṣdar-like complement clause.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive plural being verb after the complement particle
words.root_gloss_range: being and becoming; locally the subjunctive clause leaves the mocked group’s true worth open
words.prose: {{ar:يَكُونُوا۟}} ({{tr:yakūnū}}) is subjunctive after the complement particle and carries the counter-evaluation into being or becoming. The {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) field leaves status open, while feminine variant evidence functions as contrast and does not collapse the masculine-panel parallel.

topics.headline: subjunctive being
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the issue is what the mocked group may actually be or become, not what mockers currently assume.
topics.reason: The rows combine subjunctive grammar, being/becoming range, and variant-reading limits.

words.gloss_range: accusative indefinite comparative predicate in the being-clause
words.root_gloss_range: goodness, betterment, and choosing; locally an open comparative worth predicate
words.prose: {{ar:خَيْرًۭا}} ({{tr:khayran}}) is the accusative predicate of the being-clause, so the counter-evaluation lands on worth. Through {{ar:خ ي ر}} ({{tr:kh-y-r}}), goodness and choice meet: the mockers’ chosen ranking may be overturned by a better value.

topics.headline: open better worth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the mocked group’s hidden worth is left open and may exceed the mockers’ assessment.
topics.reason: The rows support accusative predicate grammar, goodness-choice semantics, and indefinite magnification of quality.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus masculine plural pronoun closing the first comparison
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) closes the first comparison by routing better-than language back to the mocking group. The pronoun makes the warning pointed: the mocked may be better than them.

topics.headline: comparison return to mockers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the comparison return directly to the mockers, making their superiority assumption the target.
topics.reason: The rows identify the suffix as referring back to the mockers and completing the comparative closure.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction carrying the same prohibition frame into a second panel
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second panel with the first. It keeps the women-specific warning inside the same prohibition-and-counter-evaluation architecture.

topics.headline: coordinated second panel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the women-specific clause is coordinated under the same moral frame rather than added as an unrelated aside.
topics.reason: The rows identify coordination of the women-panel under the same prohibition frame.

words.gloss_range: negative prohibitive particle with an elided mockery verb in the women-clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) carries prohibitive force in the women-clause even with the mockery verb elided. That ellipsis makes the second panel parallel to the first without restating every word.

topics.headline: elliptical prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices grammatical parity: the second panel repeats the prohibition even when the verb is omitted.
topics.reason: The rows support elided-verb governance and elliptical parity with the first mockery clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural women as subject of the elided mockery verb
words.root_gloss_range: women as the local lexical value; proposed delay-related derivation remains background apparatus rather than the local sense
words.prose: {{ar:نِسَآءٌۭ}} ({{tr:nisāʾun}}) supplies the subject of the elided prohibition and makes the second panel explicitly women-specific. The {{ar:ن س و}} ({{tr:n-s-w}}) derivational dispute can be noted, but locally the word functions as an indefinite plural group term balanced against the earlier group panel.

topics.headline: women panel subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a distinct women-panel, not a mere generic add-on, with its own subject under the same moral test.
topics.reason: The rows combine nominative subject grammar, indefinite plural scope, derivational dispute, and qawm-panel parallelism.

words.gloss_range: preposition repeating separation inside the women-panel
words.prose: {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}) repeats the separative relation in the women-panel. It keeps mocker and target apart inside the same category rather than changing the social logic.

topics.headline: second separative min
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same within-category separation repeated among women as among groups.
topics.reason: The rows identify the second preposition as repeating separation and partitive relation.

words.gloss_range: genitive women-target governed by the second preposition
words.root_gloss_range: women as local social category; repeated form marks target and mocker within the same category
words.prose: {{ar:نِّسَآءٍ}} ({{tr:nisāʾin}}) completes the women-from-women frame as the governed target. Repetition of {{ar:ن س و}} ({{tr:n-s-w}}) vocabulary makes the mocker and mocked mirror one another before the second counter-evaluation.

topics.headline: women target frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the mocked women named with the same category term as the mockers, preserving the mirror structure.
topics.reason: The rows support genitive governance, mirror structure with the first panel, and repeated women-category vocabulary.

words.gloss_range: second modal counter-evaluation repeating the force of the first
words.root_gloss_range: hope, possibility, and expectation; locally repeats the same counter-ranking force in the women-panel
words.prose: {{ar:عَسَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ʿasā}}) repeats the counter-evaluating modal in the women-panel. The {{ar:ع س ي}} ({{tr:ʿ-s-y}}) force again unsettles the mockers’ ranking, while feminine qiraat evidence sharpens agency as contrast without replacing the transmitted local form.

topics.headline: second modal counter evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the women-panel receives the same possible reversal of worth as the first group panel.
topics.reason: The rows support repeated modal force, hope/certainty range, and feminine variant contrast.

words.gloss_range: second complement particle linking the modal to its being-clause
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) repeats the complement dependency after the second modal. It keeps the women-panel structurally equal to the first counter-evaluation.

topics.headline: second complement dependency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the women-panel counter-evaluation built with the same dependency as the first panel.
topics.reason: The row identifies the second complement particle as repeating the same clause dependency.

words.gloss_range: feminine plural subjunctive being verb agreeing with the mocked women
words.root_gloss_range: being and becoming; locally marked in feminine plural agreement for the women-panel
words.prose: {{ar:يَكُنَّ}} ({{tr:yakunna}}) agrees in feminine plural form with the women in the target clause. The {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) field again leaves real worth open as being or becoming, and the form itself blocks a generic masculine reading of this panel.

topics.headline: feminine being clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the counter-evaluation grammatically agree with women rather than being absorbed into a generic masculine frame.
topics.reason: The rows support feminine plural agreement, being/becoming semantics, sound-form contrast, and parallelism with the earlier verb.

words.gloss_range: second accusative comparative predicate matching the earlier worth slot
words.root_gloss_range: goodness, betterment, and choosing; locally repeats the open comparative worth predicate
words.prose: {{ar:خَيْرًۭا}} ({{tr:khayran}}) occupies the same predicate slot as the earlier better-worth word. The repeated {{ar:خ ي ر}} ({{tr:kh-y-r}}) term keeps the women-panel from being softer or secondary: the same hidden superiority may belong to the mocked women.

topics.headline: second open better worth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same open-ended better-worth verdict applied to the mocked women.
topics.reason: The rows support repeated predicate grammar, goodness-choice semantics, indefinite openness, and exact structural parallel with the first panel.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus feminine plural pronoun closing the women-panel comparison
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنْهُنَّ}} ({{tr:minhunna}}) closes the women-panel comparison by routing the better-than relation back to the women who mock. The feminine pronoun keeps the warning locally specific.

topics.headline: feminine comparison closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the comparison return specifically to the women mockers.
topics.reason: The row identifies the suffix as sending the comparison back to the women mockers.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction moving from group panels into direct plural address
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the prohibition chain from the two group panels into direct address. It marks a pivot from describing groups to confronting the addressees themselves.

topics.headline: pivot to direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivot from observed group behavior into direct second-person accountability.
topics.reason: The rows identify the conjunction as the move from group panels to direct address.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive particle governing a second-person jussive verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) directly governs the following second-person jussive. The prohibition now faces the addressees without the distance of a third-person group panel.

topics.headline: direct prohibitive lamz
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the restraint become directly addressed to the community rather than framed in third person.
topics.reason: The rows support direct prohibitive governance and the shift from third person to second person.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural jussive forbidding fault-finding; Form II variant intensifies but does not replace the local Form I
words.root_gloss_range: poking, gesturing, and defaming; locally subtle fault-finding is caught by Form I under prohibition
words.prose: {{ar:تَلْمِزُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:talmizū}}) is a second-person plural jussive, so the ayah turns from group examples to direct communal restraint. The {{ar:ل م ز}} ({{tr:l-m-z}}) field moves from pointed gesture to defamation; Form II variant evidence intensifies the picture, but the local Form I already catches subtle fault-finding, with parallels such as 9:58, 9:79, and 104:1 showing the root’s social bite.

topics.headline: fault finding self directed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that even pointed or subtle fault-finding is prohibited, and the second-person form makes the audience responsible.
topics.reason: The rows support direct-address jussive grammar, gesture-to-defamation semantics, Form I/Form II narrowing, rare-root weight, inter-ayah parallels, and sound pressure.

words.gloss_range: plural self noun with second-person suffix as the object of fault-finding
words.root_gloss_range: self, soul, breath, and inner life; locally the community’s own selves are the object harmed by defamation
words.prose: {{ar:أَنفُسَكُمْ}} ({{tr:anfusakum}}) is the object of the fault-finding verb and carries a second-person plural suffix. Through {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}), self, breath, and communal personhood remain live: to defame one another is to injure your own selves, a relation echoed by self-harm and self-sacrifice contexts such as 2:54, 4:29, 49:15, and 59:9.

topics.headline: communal self object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that insulting fellow believers is framed as wounding the community’s own self.
topics.reason: The rows support object grammar, self/community overlap, breath imagery, suffix binding, distributed plural selfhood, and intra-Quranic self-field links.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the labeling prohibition without resetting the sequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the labeling ban with the fault-finding ban. It adds a fourth prohibition without resetting the moral sequence.

topics.headline: coordinated labeling ban
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees name-calling joined to fault-finding as part of one escalating chain of speech harms.
topics.reason: The rows identify coordination of labeling with fault-finding and continuation of the prohibition chain.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive particle governing reciprocal name-calling
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) governs the reciprocal labeling verb and keeps the command form explicit. It marks name-calling as another direct prohibition, not a mere advisory aside.

topics.headline: reciprocal labeling prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the next act prohibited as a direct command against reciprocal social naming.
topics.reason: The row identifies prohibitive governance over the reciprocal verb.

words.gloss_range: Form VI second-person plural jussive forbidding reciprocal name-calling
words.root_gloss_range: throwing and naming; locally Form VI makes abusive labeling reciprocal, with assimilation evidence only phonological support
words.prose: {{ar:تَنَابَزُوا۟}} ({{tr:tanābazū}}) is Form VI, so the prohibited act is reciprocal: people exchange labels rather than one side merely speaking. The {{ar:ن ب ز}} ({{tr:n-b-z}}) field links naming with throwing, making nicknames feel like social projectiles; assimilation and sound rows support the pressure at the boundary without changing the local form.

topics.headline: reciprocal thrown labels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees abusive labels as objects thrown back and forth within the community.
topics.reason: The rows support reciprocal Form VI grammar, throw-name semantics, hapax concentration, assimilation evidence, sound pressure, and the instrumental label phrase.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking labels as the instrument or means of abuse
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) marks the labels as the instrument of the reciprocal act. The harm is done by means of names, not merely accompanied by them.

topics.headline: instrumental labeling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees labels functioning as the means by which reciprocal abuse is carried out.
topics.reason: The rows identify instrumental force and agency-like function for the label phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite plural noun for labels or nicknames governed by the instrument preposition
words.root_gloss_range: labels and epithets; locally the definite plural points to the known category of nicknames turned pejorative by context
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَلْقَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-alqāb}}) is definite plural, so the warning concerns the known category of labels rather than a single nickname. The {{ar:ل ق ب}} ({{tr:l-q-b}}) noun can be neutral in itself, but inside the prohibition it becomes the instrument of pejorative social naming.

topics.headline: known label category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah targets a recognizable class of social labels, not only one insult.
topics.reason: The rows support definiteness, plurality, neutral-to-pejorative contextual narrowing, unique Quranic nickname vocabulary, and hapax concentration.

words.gloss_range: frozen verb of dispraise opening the evaluative verdict
words.root_gloss_range: wretchedness, severity, and negative valuation; locally performs condemnation of the following name
words.prose: {{ar:بِئْسَ}} ({{tr:biʾsa}}) opens the verdict clause as a fixed verb of dispraise. The {{ar:ب أ س}} ({{tr:b-ʾ-s}}) field gives the condemnation weight: the ayah is no longer only forbidding speech harms but pronouncing the resulting name wretched.

topics.headline: dispraise verdict pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah move from prohibitions into an uttered verdict of wretchedness.
topics.reason: The rows support fiʿl dhamm grammar, severe negative valuation, condemnation by utterance, and pivot from prohibitions to verdict.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative subject of the dispraise verb; naming root is locally focused on identification
words.root_gloss_range: naming, marking, and elevation; locally the word is the definite name judged by the verdict, not a sky-image claim
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلِٱسْمُ}} ({{tr:al-ismu}}) is the nominative subject of the dispraise formula: the judged thing is the name itself. The {{ar:س م و}} ({{tr:s-m-w}}) field lets naming and elevation hover in the background, but locally the payoff is identification under verdict, joined to the following deviance term.

topics.headline: the name under verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah judge the social name itself, turning the problem of abusive labels into a problem of identity.
topics.reason: The rows support subject grammar, naming-root dispute, elevation/identification range, definiteness with the following noun, and convergence of naming with blame syntax.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun naming deviance as the condemned designation
words.root_gloss_range: going out, bursting beyond bounds, and deviance; locally names the state produced by the speech violations
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفُسُوقُ}} ({{tr:al-fusūq}}) names the condemned designation after the four prohibitions. Through {{ar:ف س ق}} ({{tr:f-s-q}}), deviance is boundary-breaking, so mockery, fault-finding, and labels are gathered as a state of stepping outside faith-shaped conduct; 49:6 and 49:7 sharpen that surah-level contrast.

topics.headline: deviance name after prohibitions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior speech harms summarized as a boundary-breaking state, not as minor etiquette failures.
topics.reason: The rows support badal or predicate syntax, gerund/state force, bursting-beyond-bounds semantics, summary of the four prohibitions, and recurrence in 49:6 and 49:7.

words.gloss_range: temporal adverb attaching the verdict to what comes after faith
words.root_gloss_range: after, distance, and remoteness; locally temporal sequence carries a distance-from-faith image
words.prose: {{ar:بَعْدَ}} ({{tr:baʿda}}) sets the verdict after faith, making sequence part of the accusation. The {{ar:ب ع د}} ({{tr:b-ʿ-d}}) field also carries distance, so the phrase frames social deviance as movement away from the trust already named.

topics.headline: after faith regression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the severity depend on sequence: the deviance comes after an entered faith commitment.
topics.reason: The rows support temporal attachment, distance imagery, recurrent after-faith regression, and severity hinge.

words.gloss_range: definite Form IV verbal noun naming the faith standard after which deviance occurs
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, and faith; locally the definite Form IV verbal noun recalls the audience’s entered commitment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ}} ({{tr:al-īmān}}) closes the after-phrase as the standard from which deviance is a regression. With {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}), faith remains a trust-security commitment, and the definite form points back to the opening believer identity as the same covenantal field.

topics.headline: entered trust standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees faith as the standard violated by speech harm, not merely a background belief label.
topics.reason: The rows support Form IV verbal noun morphology, definiteness, faith/trust standard, terminal position in the after-phrase, and bookending with the opening faith verb.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the final conditional sentence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is resumptive at the opening of the final conditional sentence. It shifts the discourse from verdict wording to consequence for the one who does not turn back.

topics.headline: resumptive conditional wa
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from naming the wrong to stating accountability for refusal to repent.
topics.reason: The rows identify the conjunction as introducing a new conditional conclusion rather than another item in the prohibition list.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle universalizing the final accountability clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) opens a universal conditional: whoever falls under the condition faces the result. The ayah moves from plural communal address to individual accountability, while the final clause still closes the whole legal sequence.

topics.headline: universal conditional person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees communal instruction narrow into universal individual responsibility.
topics.reason: The rows support universal conditional scope, individualization of responsibility, five-domain scope architecture, and protasis-apodosis legal form.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator governing the repentance verb in the protasis
words.prose: {{ar:لَّمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) governs the repentance verb and negates the required turning-back. It binds the final classification to non-repentance before the response particle arrives.

topics.headline: negated repentance condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the final label is tied specifically to not repenting, not automatically to every offender.
topics.reason: The rows support jussive governance, negated repentance, and completion of the conditional protasis before the response.

words.gloss_range: jussive repentance verb after negation; the local root is turning back despite the bundle shadow
words.root_gloss_range: turning back and returning; locally corrects the bundle shadow from perishing to repentance
words.prose: {{ar:يَتُبْ}} ({{tr:yatub}}) is the last action verb before the final classification, and it names turning back. The local {{ar:ت و ب}} ({{tr:t-w-b}}) analysis corrects the bundle shadow from a perishing root to the repentance root; the simple jussive asks for an actual turn-back here, not a displayed identity of repeated repentance.

topics.headline: turning back before verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees repentance as the concrete turning point between speech harm and identity-level judgment.
topics.reason: The rows support jussive non-return after negation, tawba as directional return, correction of the t-b-b shadow to t-w-b, final action-verb position, and the narrowing from community repair to accountable person.

words.gloss_range: result particle introducing the apodosis of the conditional
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) introduces the response to the conditional because the answer begins as a demonstrative nominal clause. It makes the final classification consequential rather than disconnected.

topics.headline: conditional response fa
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final label as a consequence of the unmet condition.
topics.reason: The rows support apodosis marking and the particle arch from repair obligation to consequence.

words.gloss_range: distant demonstrative resuming the conditional subject as a classified group
words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) resumes whoever does not repent with a distant demonstrative. After the after-faith distance frame, the demonstrative helps set the non-repentant apart as a classified group.

topics.headline: distant classification subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the non-repentant set apart rhetorically before they receive the final predicate.
topics.reason: The rows support distant resumption, moral remoteness, and the opening of the apodosis classification chain.

words.gloss_range: separating pronoun between demonstrative subject and definite predicate
words.prose: {{ar:هُمُ}} ({{tr:humu}}) separates the demonstrative subject from the predicate and gives the identification restrictive force. The final seal slows into a three-part chain: those, they, the wrongdoers.

topics.headline: restrictive separating pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final identification tightened: those are the wrongdoers, not merely among them.
topics.reason: The rows support ḍamīr al-faṣl function, restriction-like force, predicate marking, and the three-part classification seal.

words.gloss_range: definite active participle plural classifying the non-repentant as wrongdoers
words.root_gloss_range: wrongdoing, misplacement, and darkness; locally names the unrepentant labelers as an active wrongdoer class
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ}} ({{tr:al-ẓālimūn}}) closes the ayah as a definite active participle, turning unrepented conduct into an identity-level classification. Through {{ar:ظ ل م}} ({{tr:ẓ-l-m}}), the label carries misplacement and darkness: those who misplace people with abusive names become the named wrongdoer class, reversing the opening faith identity.

topics.headline: wrongdoer identity reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a controlled reversal: people who misuse labels receive a justified identity label if they refuse repentance.
topics.reason: The rows support definite active participle grammar, labeler-reversal, misplacement/darkness semantics, faith-to-wrongdoer bookends, restrictive final seal, and heavy plural closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated qawm-to-qawm and women-to-women constructions are interrupted twice by the possibility that the mocked party is better.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mockery subjects another to the speaker's purpose and turns peer groups into a one-sided valuation scene. The two possibility clauses reopen the comparison, so the attempted ranking cannot settle worth.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something under command for a purpose supplies the coercive action: the target is made to serve the mocker's elevation.
Valuation and pricing turn the repeated group pairing into an attempted social appraisal.
A hoped return after apparent lack supplies latent value that may reappear and reverse the present estimate.
Chosen excellence supplies the very comparative worth that ridicule falsely claims to have measured.

changed_reading.before: A ban on making jokes at another group's expense.
changed_reading.after: A ban on manufacturing rank by coercively pricing another group when the socially discounted party may carry the greater excellence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The direct object in 'do not lamz your selves' and the reciprocal nickname construction make aggressor and target members of one grammatical self.
baseline_models.mechanism: Covert fault-finding becomes a push against the living collective, while reciprocal appellation fixes the jab into a public identifying mark. The community is both the hand that strikes and the body struck.

activation_trace.role: Covert fault-finding supplies the extraction and circulation of a defect.
Pushing or striking gives the verbal fault a bodily force against the shared self.
The living self makes the reflexive object more than an idiom: communal injury reaches a life-bearing body.
A visible identifying mark supplies the persistence by which a passing jab becomes a social label.

changed_reading.before: Do not insult fellow believers because they are like yourselves.
changed_reading.after: Fault-finding and reciprocal labeling are recursive self-injury: a member pushes a wound into the collective body and leaves it there as an identifying mark.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'bad is the name, fusuq, after faith' places designation, boundary exit, temporal succession, and prior security together.
baseline_models.mechanism: A name raises and fixes a designation; fusuq supplies an image of something breaking out of its peel. After faith's security, abusive moral naming can therefore be read as stripping a person into an exposed deviant identity rather than merely describing an act.

activation_trace.role: A name as raised designation supplies the public identity assigned to the person.
A visible identifying mark makes designation adhere as a readable social trace.
A moist date emerging from its peel supplies boundary rupture and exposure.
Settled security and trust supply the protected identity from which the imposed deviance mark dislodges the person.
Afterness supplies an identity sequence, making the badness a replacement event after faith rather than a timeless label.

changed_reading.before: Fusuq is simply condemned as a bad name after faith.
changed_reading.after: The verse condemns an identity overwrite in which public naming strips a believer's secure designation and displays the person as what has broken out of its covering.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing condition on repentance immediately names the non-returners as wrongdoers, after injuries committed against other people.
baseline_models.mechanism: The wrong leaves a grievance, misplaces a person under an imposed label, and withholds the person's right to social standing. Repentance is consequently read as reopening redress, not only changing an inward feeling.

activation_trace.role: Calling another to repent keeps repentance socially answerable and open to an injured party's demand.
Grievance and the search for redress supply the unresolved claim left by verbal injury.
Concrete misplacement supplies the social wrong of fixing a person in an improper identity or position.
Withholding a right makes the injury a deprivation that repair must reverse.

changed_reading.before: The offender must privately repent or remain unjust.
changed_reading.after: Because ridicule and labeling generate a grievance and social misplacement, repentance remains incomplete as a merely private state; it points toward restored standing and redress.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement from forbidden precedence to raised speech and then lowered voices supplies a vertical grammar for conduct. Ridicule becomes a verbal attempt to advance and rise in rank by forcing another downward.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful subjection anchors the downward force exerted on the mocked party.
Forward precedence supplies the unauthorized self-advancement later reproduced socially by ridicule.
Literal voice elevation supplies the audible vehicle of attempted status elevation.
Elevation of rank converts the spatial 'above' into the social hierarchy that mockery tries to stage.
Restraint through lowering supplies the opposite practice: reduce one's own projection rather than another's standing.

structural_cues: 49:1-3 moves in order from not advancing, to not raising speech above, to lowering one's own voice.
49:11 repeats peer-to-peer comparison and then destabilizes its hierarchy with two possibility clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forward precedence, raised and above speech, and restrained lowering; I infer that ridicule performs social elevation through verbal lowering of another. The live alternative is that the earlier vertical cues regulate prophetic etiquette only, making this transfer analogical.

changed_reading.before: Mockery expresses an already-held sense of superiority.
changed_reading.after: Mockery is itself a technology for producing superiority: the speaker advances and rises by making the target carry the downward position.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from hearts whose contents are disclosed by testing, through callers outside an enclosure, to patient waiting for emergence that would be better. The mocked person's greater worth can thus be presently enclosed, inward, or not yet emerged; ridicule judges from outside too early.

activation_trace.role: Hoped return supplies latent value that is absent from current view but not absent in reality.
A test that reveals what is in the heart locates decisive quality beneath public appearance.
An enclosed place supplies the boundary outside which impatient callers lack access.
Holding the self back supplies the temporal discipline required before evaluating what is concealed.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the delayed disclosure of worth.
Excellence appearing after patient emergence directly sharpens the focus verse's twice-withheld comparison.

structural_cues: 49:4-5 contrasts calling from outside the chambers with waiting until the addressed person comes out, and explicitly calls the latter better.
49:11 repeats 'perhaps they are better' for both social pairings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosed space, inward testing, restraint, emergence, and betterment; I infer that these spatial and temporal relations model socially hidden worth. The alternative is a narrower lesson about waiting for physical access, with no transfer to comparison in 49:11.

changed_reading.before: The mocker may simply be mistaken about which party is better.
changed_reading.after: The mocker commits premature disclosure: judging from outside before inward or future worth has had the conditions to emerge.

context_deltas.mechanism: An insulting designation compresses a claim about a person into a portable report. The report sequence in 49:6 requires disclosure and clarification before a group is hit; focus labeling bypasses that gate, turns a suspected fault into a target, and leaves a durable aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Covert fault-finding supplies the untested content that a label circulates as if established.
A report arriving and being transmitted supplies the social mobility of an accusation or nickname.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign supplies the verification gate that hostile designation skips.
Aimed impact supplies the causal conversion of an unchecked claim into injury against a target.
Absence of knowledge identifies the epistemic condition under which the targeting occurs.
A remaining trace supplies the persistence of harm after the speaker recognizes the mistake.

structural_cues: The branchless reciprocal naming construction at 49:11 words 27-28 supplies the compact designation event without licensing invented branch IDs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a transmitted report, a clarification gate, ignorant targeting, and aftermath; I infer that a hostile label functions as a compressed report about identity. The alternative is that only propositional news, not appellations, falls under the report mechanism.

changed_reading.after: A nickname is also an unverified identity report: it packages a covert suspicion, bypasses clarification, and repeatedly re-aims the group at its bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Faith is beautified in hearts and later described as entering them, while the focus name inventory supplies a public mark. Hostile naming is therefore a rival inscription: it freezes an exterior identity while inward moral formation remains hidden and dynamic.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies the externally readable identity imposed by naming.
Making beauty manifest supplies an alternative inscription of faith that originates with God rather than peer branding.
The pure core of a thing locates the relevant formation beneath the public surface.
Entry into an interior makes faith a process of inward arrival rather than an identity peers can read off a label.

structural_cues: 49:7 places faith, adornment, hearts, and aversion to fusuq in one sequence.
49:14 distinguishes spoken profession from faith's entry into hearts, while 49:11 juxtaposes name, fusuq, and faith.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exterior marking, inner beautification, a core, and inward entry; I infer that abusive naming competes with God's hidden formation of identity. The alternative is that the inward and outward cues concern sincerity only and do not govern ordinary labels.

changed_reading.before: The verse rejects ugly labels because they misdescribe believers.
changed_reading.after: It rejects peer branding as a rival identity-making process that hardens an exterior mark over an inward faith still being formed and disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The service branch of mockery and the gift branch of betterment make ridicule a one-sided status economy: the target performs unpaid labor for the mocker's claim of surplus merit. Context reverses ownership by locating favor with God and exposing recalled benefaction as a burden laid on its recipient.

activation_trace.role: Compelled unpaid service supplies the target's extraction as material for someone else's status gain.
Beneficence and gift keep genuine good in a giving rather than self-exalting economy.
Claiming surplus merit supplies the status assertion performed by the mocker.
Favor as a gift relocates excellence away from self-owned rank.
Reminding a beneficiary of a favor supplies the burdening transaction by which asserted goodness dominates another.
A gentle gift sent toward one held in affection supplies the non-coercive countereconomy.

structural_cues: 49:17 reverses the direction of human boasting by making guidance God's favor upon the speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unpaid service, claimed surplus, gift, burdensome reminder, and gentle giving; I infer that ridicule extracts status from another's humiliation. The live alternative is that the service branch is too distant from ordinary derision here, so this remains exploratory.

changed_reading.before: Mockery spends a target's dignity for amusement.
changed_reading.after: Mockery conscripts the target into unpaid status labor, while the context denies the mocker ownership of the very surplus merit being claimed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two believing parties can turn against one another, yet remain bound as siblings requiring repair and rebalancing. The focus's group-to-group mockery and 'your selves' become a verbal form of factional conflict inside one body, with repentance oriented toward repaired relation.

activation_trace.role: The living self anchors the claim that opposing members still constitute one injured body.
Mutual combat between two sides supplies the escalated factional structure echoed by group-against-group speech.
Removing aversion between people supplies the relational repair required after verbal aggression.
Equivalence and matching supply the rebalancing that counters ridicule's manufactured hierarchy.
Sibling kinship supplies the durable relation that conflict does not erase and that makes injury reflexive.

structural_cues: 49:9-10 retains the name believers for opposed parties and then restates them as siblings requiring repair.
49:11 immediately shifts to group-against-group and uses 'your selves' as the object of fault-finding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two-sided combat, kinship, repair, and balancing; I infer a structural analogy between verbal faction-making and civil conflict, not a claim that every insult chronologically causes combat. The alternative is that 49:11 is only individual etiquette after a separate legal conflict rule.

changed_reading.before: The verse protects individuals from rude peers.
changed_reading.after: It interrupts factional conflict at the level of speech: group mockery is civil aggression within one sibling body, and its remedy must rebalance relation rather than merely silence words.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context lays out a material sequence from suspicion to hidden probing, absent mention, and consumption of a dead sibling's flesh. Focus fault-finding and naming fit an earlier crystallization point: an imagined defect is probed, extracted, and fixed as the portion by which the group consumes the person.

activation_trace.role: Covert fault-finding supplies the defect selected for extraction and circulation.
Suspicion as accusation supplies the unverified seed from which a fixed identity claim grows.
Secret tracking of a report supplies the probing stage that seeks material for the label.
Mentioning a person in absence supplies circulation without the bearer's ability to answer or change the mark.
Corruption and tale-bearing between people connect verbal circulation to social consumption.
Stripping flesh from bone supplies the reduction of a whole person to one consumable exposed feature.
Loss of life and agency supplies the target's inability to contest the identity consumed in absence.

structural_cues: 49:12 orders suspicion, spying, backbiting, eating, sibling flesh, and death in a single escalating image.
49:11 orders mockery, covert fault-finding, and reciprocal appellation before naming the shared self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accusation, covert probing, absent circulation, corruption between people, flesh-stripping, and lost agency; I infer a pipeline in which a label makes one fault socially consumable. The alternative is that the flesh image applies only to backbiting and should not be extended backward to ridicule or nicknames.

changed_reading.before: Mockery, fault-finding, nicknames, and backbiting are neighboring speech offenses.
changed_reading.after: They can form an extraction pipeline: suspicion selects a fault, probing isolates it, naming fixes it, and circulation consumes that fragment in place of the living person.

context_deltas.mechanism: Created distinctions and collective names are relational infrastructure: peoples gather tribes, groups face one another, and marks enable recognition. Competitive claims to honor corrupt that infrastructure by turning a coordinate for encounter into a vertical verdict of worth.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark anchors the legitimate informational function that hostile appellation deforms.
Calling or naming a thing makes the creation of social groupings simultaneously an act of designation.
A people that gathers tribes supplies a higher grouping whose function includes connection, not only separation.
A group whose members face one another supplies reciprocal encounter rather than a ladder of rank.
Recognition after a trace or sign supplies the proper use of identity marks.
Competitive boasting in nobility supplies the corrupted use of difference that ridicule performs.

structural_cues: 49:13 pairs created sex difference with peoples and tribes, assigns mutual recognition as purpose, and relocates honor to a criterion at God.
The branchless appellation words at 49:11 words 27-28 are retained only as the structural naming cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies designation, gathering groups, face-to-face relation, recognition by signs, and competitive nobility; I infer that identity categories are meant as coordinates for encounter and are corrupted when used as rank verdicts. The alternative is a narrower anti-boasting contrast without a general account of naming.

changed_reading.before: The verse bans derogatory group labels and the next verse celebrates diversity.
changed_reading.after: The focus protects the social infrastructure of naming itself: marks and group names should make mutual recognition possible, not convert created difference into competitive honor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recognition can proceed from signs, but its inventory also contains the figure who claims hidden knowledge. Later speech can appropriate judgment over another, while the sequence reserves full disclosure of inward religion, unseen reality, and action to God. Mockery overreads a visible sign into a verdict on hidden worth.

activation_trace.role: Valuation and pricing anchor the human judgment of comparative worth being challenged.
The diviner who claims hidden knowledge supplies recognition's dangerous overreach into invisible states.
Speech that appropriates judgment over another supplies the act performed when a label becomes a verdict.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the epistemic standard human ranking cannot claim for itself.
What is screened from eyes supplies the hidden domain into which ridicule falsely projects certainty.
Insight of the heart supplies the penetrating sight attributed in the closing context, beyond peer observation.

structural_cues: 49:13 locates the decisive honor criterion 'at God'.
49:16 rejects informing God about religion, and 49:18 closes with knowledge of the unseen and sight of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign-based recognition, pretended hidden knowledge, appropriated judgment, disclosure, unseen reality, and inward sight; I infer that ridicule usurps epistemic jurisdiction over worth. The alternative is that the closing knowledge formulas establish divine omniscience without directly reframing peer comparison.

changed_reading.before: The mocker makes a morally unreliable comparison.
changed_reading.after: The mocker acts as a counterfeit knower: a visible feature is overread into hidden worth, and a spoken label appropriates judgment that the surrounding sequence reserves to fuller knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant S-M-M mapping of the focus name root and crosses from poison and peel to social identity. It remains packet-valid because the split mapping is explicitly supplied, the focus juxtaposes name, fusuq, and faith, and 49:14 supplies inward entry. Render it only as a material analogy, never as a claim that the surface word for name literally means poison here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places name beside peel-breaking fusuq after faith; the context then describes faith as entering hearts.

activation_trace.role: Poison entering a body supplies the exploratory image of an imposed name penetrating the shared social self.
A date emerging from its peel supplies the opposite boundary movement: the marked person is exposed as outside.
Settled security supplies the protected communal condition disrupted by penetration and expulsion.
Entry into an interior supplies faith's proper inward motion against the label's invasive motion.
The heart supplies the interior body-space in which the two directional movements are contrasted.

changed_reading.before: A bad label sits on a person's surface.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the label behaves like a penetrant that enters the communal body and reverses faith's inward movement by pushing its bearer outward through an exposed deviance identity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects the warning about raised speech and collapsing deeds to the focus insult through wound imagery. It stays anchored in the focus's pushing lamz and grievance-bearing zulm, with packet branches for abusive hearing, wound relapse, and fine awareness. Render it as an asymmetry of hidden consequence, not as a legal claim that every insult automatically nullifies all deeds.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus gives fault-finding a pushing force and closes with an unresolved grievance when the speaker does not return.

activation_trace.role: Pushing or striking anchors speech as an impact rather than a vanishing sound.
A grievance seeking redress supplies the injury that persists beyond the utterance.
Making another hear ugly abuse makes the divine-hearing closure acoustically specific to verbal harm.
A wound relapsing and retaining a trace supplies the target-side persistence and speaker-side hidden loss.
Fine awareness supplies the faculty explicitly absent when the consequence develops below the speaker's notice.

changed_reading.before: The insult ends when its sound ends, though it may have offended someone.
changed_reading.after: The utterance can leave a relapsing trace in the target and a hidden collapse in the speaker's own moral work, with neither consequence proportionate to what the speaker noticed.

strongest_changes: Mockery shifted from an expression of rank to a mechanism that manufactures rank by subjecting and pricing another.
A nickname became both an unverified identity report and an exterior mark competing with inward faith formation.
The shared-self grammar, sibling context, and repair sequence turned verbal injury into factional self-harm requiring relational redress.
Created group names shifted from neutral categories to recognition infrastructure that ridicule corrupts into competitive honor.
The final knowledge sequence exposed ridicule as an overclaim to hidden judgment rather than merely an inaccurate opinion.
summary.what_was_special: The split name inventory allowed designation and visible marking to coexist with a contained penetrant image, while the context moved through vertical speech, report verification, inner formation, repair, material consumption, recognition, and unseen knowledge without forcing those mechanisms into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The vertical and unpaid-service readings depend on analogical transfer from speech etiquette and distant branches, though both remain visibly anchored in mockery and comparison.
The peel, poison, and inward-entry model is materially coherent but branch-distant and must remain exploratory.
The concealed-worth model leaves open whether the better party's value is inward, temporally emergent, socially unseen, or all three.
The report and flesh pipelines may describe adjacent speech offenses rather than one causal sequence in every case.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Mockery converts persons into instruments of rank.** س خ ر B003 is direct derision, while B001/B002 picture bringing under command and pressing into unpaid service. The repeated group-over-group comparison supplies a status relation. I infer that ridicule conscripts another person's exposed trait to perform the mocker's superiority. The prohibition resists instrumentalization as well as insult.
2. **Fault-finding strikes the same social self.** ل م ز B001 gives covert blame and B002 pushing or striking; ن ف س B011/B012 gives the living self and the very thing itself. The reflexive *anfusakum* is packet-given. I infer that the brotherhood established in 49:10 makes a strike against another circulate through one's own corporate self. The grammar is causal social anatomy, not rhetorical exaggeration.
3. **Nicknames can replace persons with shells.** ن ب ز B001 is labeling and B002 husk material; ل ق ب B001 is an added meaning-bearing name and B002 "clothing a noun"; س م و B005 is raised designation; ف س ق B002 is emergence from a peel. The packet supplies reciprocal labeling and a bad *ism*. I infer that hostile labels clothe the person in an imposed shell, then make that shell the public identity. The ayah attacks reputational substitution.
4. **The temporal reversal is itself the injustice.** ب ع د B002 gives afterness, ء م ن B001 settled trust, and ظ ل م B004 doing something at the wrong time or place. The ayah explicitly places the bad name after faith. I infer that returning a trusted person to an exclusionary designation violates the new social time. Failure to turn back preserves that temporal misplacement.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 49:13's legitimate group differences corrected the ayah away from erasing collective identity: the target is status violence through identity, not groups as such. 49:14's inaccurate self-label "we believe" also showed that imposed names and self-chosen names alike can outrun the inward state they claim.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Mockery is a bid to subordinate, defeated by inaccessible comparative worth.** `س خ ر:B003` is derision, but `س خ ر:B001` images bringing something under command for a purpose and `س خ ر:B002` imposed, unpaid service. Those dormant branches make mockery function as a social reduction of another group into material for the mocker’s status. `خ ي ر:B002` supplies chosen excellence, while 49:13 locates honor with God and 49:16 contrasts human claims with divine knowledge. The packet gives mockery, subjection, possible superiority, and hidden evaluation; I infer that ridicule falsely assumes control over a ranking whose decisive evidence the ridiculer does not possess.

2. **Covert fault-finding lands as a blow on the shared self.** `ل م ز:B001` covers hidden blame, defect-tracking, and signaling by eye or mouth; `ل م ز:B002` adds physical pushing or striking. Its object is **أَنفُسَكُمْ**, anchored in `ن ف س:B012`, the very self or whole identity. Brotherhood in 49:10 and the brother’s flesh in 49:12 supply the collective relation; I infer that a covert verbal thrust at another member rebounds upon the community’s own body. The unusual self-object therefore reads as a causal claim about shared injury, not only a rhetorical reminder.

3. **A nickname can forcibly relocate a person’s public identity.** `ن ب ز:B001` is naming or taunting by nickname, and `ل ق ب:B001` is an added name attached to a person for a perceived trait. `س م و:B005` makes **ٱلِٱسْمُ** a raised designation, with `س م و:B008` adding public repute; `ب ع د:B003` supplies created distance. The packet gives attachment of a new designation and “after faith”; I infer that hostile naming elevates one selected trait into a public identity and pushes the named person away from the trust-bearing designation (`ء م ن:B001`). **بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ** thus condemns identity reassignment as a boundary rupture (`ف س ق:B002`).

4. **Wrongdoing here is misplacement that withholds rightful standing.** The retained `ظ ل م:B004` images putting an act in the wrong time or place, and `ظ ل م:B008` withholding rights; `ظ ل م:B003` supplies the resulting grievance and demand for redress. Mockery, fault-finding, and labels all place a person beneath an unproved ranking and deny the standing established by brotherhood. The packet supplies these images; I infer that failure to return leaves that imposed social placement in force. **ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ** therefore names not generic badness but sustained reputational dispossession.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayat 49:14–17 show that self-labeling can repeat the same offense as hostile labeling: both make a designation decide standing before divine knowledge does. `س م و:B005` therefore links imposed nicknames to inflated confessional names, while 49:18 reserves final appraisal for known deeds.

baseline.text: Ey iman edenler! Bir topluluk başka bir toplulukla alay etmesin; belki alay edilenler kendilerinden daha iyidir. Kadınlar da başka kadınlarla alay etmesin; belki onlar kendilerinden daha iyidir. Birbirinizi ayıplamayın ve birbirinizi lakaplarla çağırmayın. İman ettikten sonra yoldan çıkmışlıkla anılmak ne kötüdür! Kim tövbe etmezse işte onlar haksızlık edenlerdir.

findings.text: Alay, başkasının açığa çıkan özelliğini alay edenin üstünlüğüne hizmet eden bir araca dönüştürerek kişiyi toplumsal olarak boyunduruk altına alır.
Bir başkasındaki kusuru gizlice dürtmek, kardeşlik nedeniyle ortak toplumsal benliğe yönelen bir darbe gibi geri döner.
Düşmanca lakap, kişiye eklenen bir adı kamusal itibara yükseltip seçilmiş tek bir özelliği kişinin bütün kimliğinin yerine geçirir.
İmandan sonra dışlayıcı adlandırmayı sürdürmek, kişiyi yeni güven ilişkisi içindeki yerinden uzaklaştıran zamansal ve toplumsal bir hak gaspıdır.
Sorun yalnız başkasının taktığı ad değildir; daha sonraki iman iddiası, kişinin kendi seçtiği adın da iç durumunu aşarak hüküm vermeye kalkabileceğini gösterir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Vertical Calibration of Voice and Standing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Social relation is made audible and spatial through controlled height: voices rise or lower, and persons are elevated by genuine standing rather than self-assertion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Acoustic altitude becomes a diagnostic of social rank, yet the surah reverses the expected ladder by locating durable elevation in restraint and protected character.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Received Standing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Standing is elevated by tested quality, prior good, and conferred distinction rather than by the claimant's own lift.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: elevation in rank `quranic:root_000582:B002/m01`; height or loftiness `quranic:root_000745:B001/m01`; superior rank `quranic:root_001188:B002/m01`; granted distinction `quranic:root_001163:B002/m01`; inherent honor `quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`; greatness `quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`; public honor and inviolability `quranic:root_001029:B010/m01`; prior standing in good `quranic:root_001207:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: elevation and "above" occur at 49:2-3; greatness and reward at 49:3; distinction at 49:8; the name/height root at 49:11, 16, and 18; honor at 49:13; precedence at 49:1.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rank language extends the voice scale into a social hierarchy, but its stable forms are received or recognized: tested quality, prior good, granted distinction, and protected honor. The scale is real, yet persons do not establish their own position merely by speaking from above.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Fractured relations are restored by stopping violence, rejoining separated parts, and setting the whole to a just line and measure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Social repair takes material form as patching a vessel, draining a wound, setting a bone, hearing a grievance, balancing a load, and weaving kinship tissue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Entrusting the Grievance to a Wise Arbiter
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An injured party presents a grievance to a delegated judge whose knowledge produces a firm and equitable decision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: judicial decision between people `quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`; wisdom that reaches the right judgment `quranic:root_000348:B003/m01`; firm and secured decision `quranic:root_000348:B004/m01`; delegated arbitration `quranic:root_000348:B005/m01`; grievance seeking redress `quranic:root_000967:B003/m01`; justice `quranic:root_000991:B001/m01`; equitable dealing `quranic:root_001224:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: wisdom and judgment occur at 49:8; justice and equity at 49:9; grievance/wrongdoing at 49:11.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Settlement requires a competent decision-maker, not only willing parties. The grievance supplies the claim, delegated authority supplies jurisdiction, wisdom identifies the right outcome, and firmness prevents the decision from dissolving under renewed pressure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human plurality is formed from one measured origin and becomes socially legible through faces, signs, group structure, and names.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same social world can be born through one womb, assembled as fitted branches, made familiar through encounter, or damaged when mockery and hostile labels manufacture distance and reputation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mockery as Social Subjugation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A mocker assumes superior standing, reduces another to an instrument or unpaid subordinate, and judges worth without knowing who is better.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: subjugating a thing for one's use `quranic:root_000685:B001/m01`; forced labor without wage `quranic:root_000685:B002/m01`; ridicule and mockery `quranic:root_000685:B003/m01`; beneficial good `quranic:root_000452:B001/m01`; selected excellence `quranic:root_000452:B002/m01`; choosing what is better `quranic:root_000452:B003/m01`; claiming superiority `quranic:root_001163:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: benefit and patient waiting occur at 49:5; distinction at 49:8; mockery and the possibility of the other's being better occur at 49:11.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Mockery is a hierarchy-making act. Its same-root senses show the inferior treated as usable or exploitable, while the comparative-good senses expose the mocker's lack of grounds for selection. The scene reframes ridicule as an unauthorized assignment of rank and role.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human plurality is formed from one measured origin and becomes socially legible through faces, signs, group structure, and names.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same social world can be born through one womb, assembled as fitted branches, made familiar through encounter, or damaged when mockery and hostile labels manufacture distance and reputation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A Hostile Name Pushes Kin Away
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An added name creates social distance, turns close kin into outsiders, and can extend disagreement into lasting hostility.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: temporal and relational "after" `quranic:root_000131:B002/m01`; distance from proximity `quranic:root_000131:B001/m01`; making two parties distant `quranic:root_000131:B003/m01`; banishment from good `quranic:root_000131:B004/m01`; distant kin opposed to close relatives `quranic:root_000131:B005/m01`; hostility carried far `quranic:root_000131:B010/m01`; added epithet `quranic:root_001367:B001/m01`; insulting nickname `quranic:root_001467:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: every distance, "after," epithet, and nickname root in this scene occurs at 49:11.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The phrase "after faith" opens a temporal hinge into a spatial process. A hostile epithet does not remain attached only to a word; it pushes its target away from recognized good and from the proximity of kin. Repeated naming can therefore convert a momentary insult into durable social exile.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: male, female, creation, and reception/facing occur at 49:13; womb/mercy at 49:5, 10, 12, and 14; self/childbirth at 49:11 and 15.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The one-origin claim is given an embodied process. Differentiated persons are generated within one containing organ and received into the world through dependent birth. Peoples and tribes therefore begin from shared vulnerability before they become social lines of distinction.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Korkunun kalkmasi, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanlarini birlikte tasiyan en kisa genel karsiliktir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik ya da tasdik degil; duada kabul talebini bildiren sabit sozdur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal belirli bir dua sozu ve onu soyleme eylemiyle sinirlidir; buradan genel guven ya da tasdik anlami cikarilmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak dali dua icinde soylenen ve kabul istegi tasiyan sabit bir soz olarak anlatir. Ayni iddia, bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve sozun anlamina dair 'kabul et' ya da 'oyle olsun' aciklamalarini da icerir; ad yorumu ise bu ortak malzemenin yan aktarimidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir şeyi bir buyruk ya da istenen sonuç doğrultusunda boyun eğdirme, yöneltme ve elverişli kılma çekirdeğinde birleşir. Bir kimse için kolaylaştırma ile geminin söz dinleyip rahat yol alması, bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir; bunlar alay etme ya da ücretsiz çalıştırma anlamını bu dala katmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, amaçlı boyun eğdirme ve elverişli kılmayla sınırlıdır; karşılıksız emek ve alay ayrı dallarda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, eylem adlarındaki genel çekirdeği korur; bir kimse için kolaylaştırma ve geminin söz dinlemesi gibi kuruluşlara bağlı kullanımları ayrıca sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bir buyruğa veya istenen işe boyun eğdirerek o işe yöneltmek ve elverişli kılmaktır. Bir kimse için kolaylaştırma ile geminin söz dinleyip rahat yol alması bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Bir şey, kimi zaman zor kullanılarak, belirli bir işe boyun eğdirilir ve istenen sonuca doğru yöneltilir.
Boyun eğdirme çekirdeği, bir şeyi bir kimsenin yararlanmasına elverişli ve kolay duruma getirmeyi de kapsar.
Gemiye bağlı kullanımda geminin söz dinlemesi, gidişinin rahatlaması ve rüzgarın ona uygun olması anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyi buyruğa veya belirli bir işe boyun eğdirip yöneltme konusunda birleşir. Toplu anlatım ayrıca bir kimse için kolaylaştırmayı ve geminin uygun rüzgarla söz dinleyerek rahat ilerlemesini bu çekirdeğin bağlı görünümleri olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi istenen işe boyun eğdirip yöneltme
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın bütün çekirdeği için kullanılır; amaçlı yöneltmeyi ve denetim altına almayı birlikte taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Boyun eğdirilen bir şeyi istenen işe yöneltme çekirdeğini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin bir kimsenin denetimine ve yararlanmasına hazır kılındığı bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Denetime verme ve yararlanmaya hazır kılma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Her durumda belirli bir işe doğru yöneltmeyi ve gemiye bağlı söz dinleme görünümünü açıkça taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin bir kimse için elverişli duruma getirildiği kuruluşta kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kimse için elverişli ve kolay duruma getirme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Boyun eğdirme, denetim altına alma ve belirli işe yöneltme çekirdeğini tek başına vermez.

bir şeyi buyruğa boyun eğdirip biri için kolaylaştırmak
